posts.cooked:
The final editor’s note. I fully support FRG having the right to pull the plug on a brand which they could no longer afford, but if they could have waited just a week longer, not only would the planned science editor’s note #90 have happened, but they might have gotten Disparation out months earlier, given how incredibly close it was to finished when they pulled the plug.

If Raymond Mantae’s paranoia is what keeps Dark Visionary from killing him, I would in fact say that he is not TOO paranoid.

Smart Thinker put out two ideas in this episode’s letters which reflect interestingly on each other: a singular entity of patience, and a Newsiverse where that entity has clearly never been, any more than The Fervor has gone to a universe where The Grey absorbed all other realms.

“things Ra does other than Fanatic” snort

posts.cooked:
I think Soothsayer Carmichael would respect Rambler, post his time working for a Gloomy; and would be likely to grow to like him if they interacted for a while. Given the forces Rambler contends with, he kinda doesn’t have the option of doing it too wrong OR not wrong at all; he has to gamble, and I feel like Cedric would see what he’s doing and with who, and go “if you have to have contact with these things at all, then twisting the word of your bargain with them is really your only option.” So he’d have a grudging admiration despite not fully approving. I think they could be bros. Likely they never canonically meet, but I kinda want them to.

Really pleased with Adam’s answer to the mummy question.

Wager Master would totally do a Guise lookalike contest.

These guys are forgetting their own lore; they said they didn’t expect to live to 2351, when it’s already been established that Christopher will upload his brain to a computer so he’ll never truly die,vehicle Adam will die but the Cult of Gloom IPAs he’s been drinking for years will rouse his dread spectre from the grave, essentially becoming a visual art equivalent of Grimm, and then he and Christopher.mp7 will just keep doing the podcast until the end of turn. (Obviously Trevor will also need to be involved somehow, but I’m not sure what his “thing” will be, since both mad science and dark magic are taken.)
